newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged, seen down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged, seen down.

text.p: Pakistan cotton rates ended unchanged on Wednesday in lacklustre trading on lack of demand from mill owners but are expected to tumble next month on arrival of the new cotton crop, dealers said.

"Mill owners are short of funds and there is little demand for cotton at these levels," dealer Khushi Ram said. "Most deals are being made on credit. The prices will slump in the coming weeks on the arrival of new crop," he said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 1,900 rupees ($47.24) per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
